realization_policy: Every actual result remains null until a dated project- and unit-specific PLN/ESDM/operator source independently confirms event type (commissioned, construction, PPA), name, capacity and date. A planned COD occurring in the past is not evidence of commissioning.
not_representative_warning: Sample row totals are NOT province-level RUPTL capacities and must not be summed as full provincial pipelines.
